name: Alert
description: Always vigilant, you react swiftly to danger and coordinate initiative with comrades.
bullets: Initiative Proficiency: You add your Proficiency Bonus (+2 at L1) to your Initiative rolls.
Initiative Swap: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative roll with the Initiative roll of one willing ally who can see or hear you.

name: Crafter
description: You are adept at crafting tools, gear, and negotiating artisan discounts.
bullets: Tool Proficiency: You gain proficiency with three different Artisan's Tools of your choice.
Discount: Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20 percent discount on it.
Fast Crafting: When you finish a Long Rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table if you have the required tools and raw materials.

name: Healer
description: You have the training and instincts to patch up wounds and revive fallen allies.
bullets: Battle Medic: When you use a Healer's Kit on a creature to stabilize them, they also regain 1 Hit Point.
Healing Rerolls: Whenever you cast a spell or use a feature that restores Hit Points, you can reroll any 1s on the healing dice.

name: Lucky
description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to bend fate in your favor when you need it most.
bullets: Luck Points: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus (2 at L1). You regain all expended Luck Points when you finish a Long Rest.

Advantage / Disadvantage: When you make a d20 roll, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on the roll. When an attack hits you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to give the attacker Disadvantage on the attack roll.

name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
description: You have learned the basics of divine prayer and spellcasting.
bullets: Two Cantrips: Choose two cantrips from the Cleric spell list (e.g. Guidance, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying).

One 1st-Level Spell: Choose one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list (e.g. Bless, Cure Wounds, Healing Word). You always have it prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot, as well as using available slots.
Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat).

name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
description: You have learned the basics of primal communion and nature spellcraft.
bullets: Two Cantrips: Choose two cantrips from the Druid spell list (e.g. Druidcraft, Guidance, Shillelagh, Thorn Whip).

One 1st-Level Spell: Choose one level 1 spell from the Druid spell list (e.g. Entangle, Goodberry, Healing Word, Thunderwave). You always have it prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat).

name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
description: You have learned the fundamentals of scholarly arcane spellcasting.
bullets: Two Cantrips: Choose two cantrips from the Wizard spell list (e.g. Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost).

One 1st-Level Spell: Choose one level 1 spell from the Wizard spell list (e.g. Shield, Magic Missile, Find Familiar, Feather Fall). You always have it prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat).

name: Musician
description: You are a master entertainer capable of inspiring the hearts of your companions during rests.
bullets: Instrument Training: You gain proficiency with three Musical Instruments of your choice.

Inspiring Song: As you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest, you can play a song on a musical instrument. When you do, choose a number of allies within 30 feet equal to your PB (+2 at L1). Each chosen ally gains Heroic Inspiration.

name: Savage Attacker
description: You strike with brutal force, maximizing damage on your weapon hits.
bullets: Brutal Strikes: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either total.

name: Skilled
description: You have dedicated yourself to learning a broad variety of arts and skills.
bullets: Versatile Mastery: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble barroom brawls, you can fight with fists and improvised items.
bullets: Enhanced Unarmed Strike: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, its damage is 1d4 + Strength modifier instead of 1.
Damage Rerolls: Whenever you roll damage for an Unarmed Strike, you can reroll any 1s on the damage die.
Push: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can push them 5 feet away from you (once per turn).

name: Tough
description: Your physical fortitude gives you extraordinary endurance and vitality.
bullets: Hit Point Maximum: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level (increases by 2 at Level 1, and +2 each level thereafter).
